#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
SRC=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul
OBJ=/tmp/mrbbuild/obj
OUT=/tmp/mrbbuild
mkdir -p "$OBJ"

CFLAGS="-std=gnu99 -g -O0 -Wall -Werror-implicit-function-declaration -fsanitize=address,undefined -DMRB_DEBUG -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL -I$SRC/include -I$SRC/build/host/include -I$SRC/mrbgems/mruby-time/include -I$SRC/mrbgems/mruby-io/include"

# Read source list (paths relative to SRC)
while IFS= read -r rel; do
  [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
  # skip the bin tools (mirb, mrbc, mruby, mruby-strip) - they have main()
  case "$rel" in
    mrbgems/mruby-bin-mirb/*|mrbgems/mruby-bin-mrbc/*|mrbgems/mruby-bin-mruby/*|mrbgems/mruby-bin-strip/*) continue;;
  esac
  srcfile="$SRC/$rel"
  if [ ! -f "$srcfile" ]; then echo "MISSING: $srcfile"; continue; fi
  # obj name: replace / with _
  objname=$(echo "$rel" | tr '/' '_' | sed 's/\.c$/.o/')
  echo "CC $rel"
  gcc $CFLAGS -c "$srcfile" -o "$OBJ/$objname" 2> "$OBJ/$objname.err" || { echo "FAIL $rel"; cat "$OBJ/$objname.err"; exit 1; }
done < /tmp/srclist.txt

echo "=== archiving ==="
ar rcs "$OUT/libmruby.a" "$OBJ"/*.o
echo "DONE: $OUT/libmruby.a"
ls -la "$OUT/libmruby.a"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/build_mruby.sh
bash /tmp/build_mruby.sh 2>&1 | tail -40

    mrbgems/mruby-bin-mirb/*|mrbgems/mruby-bin-mrbc/*|mrbgems/mruby-bin-mruby/*|mrbgems/mruby-bin-strip/*) continue;;
  esac
  srcfile="$SRC/$rel"
  if [ ! -f "$srcfile" ]; then echo "MISSING: $srcfile"; continue; fi
  # obj name: replace / with _
  objname=$(echo "$rel" | tr '/' '_' | sed 's/\.c$/.o/')
  echo "CC $rel"
  gcc $CFLAGS -c "$srcfile" -o "$OBJ/$objname" 2> "$OBJ/$objname.err" || { echo "FAIL $rel"; cat "$OBJ/$objname.err"; exit 1; }
done < /tmp/srclist.txt

echo "=== archiving ==="
ar rcs "$OUT/libmruby.a" "$OBJ"/*.o
echo "DONE: $OUT/libmruby.a"
ls -la "$OUT/libmruby.a"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/build_mruby.sh
bash /tmp/build_mruby.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
